question: Which industry has the largest YoY decline in net profit margin (consolidated statements) from H1 2024 to H1 2025?

method.metric: net_profit_margin_pct = SUM(net_profit)/SUM(revenue)*100 per industry-period (revenue-weighted, industry treated as one entity)
method.yoy_decline: delta_pp = margin_2025H1_pct - margin_2024H1_pct; smallest (most negative) delta_pp wins
method.rounding: margins and delta kept/compared at 2 decimals per dataset ratio rule

data_quality_checks.panel_balance: 172 companies and 39 industries in BOTH H1-2024 and H1-2025 consolidated slices -> balanced panel, no universe restriction needed
data_quality_checks.no_missing: revenue and net_profit non-null everywhere; revenue>0 for all consolidated H1 rows (zero-revenue rows exist only in 母公司报表, excluded)
data_quality_checks.sign_direction: max(delta_pp) positive (研究和试验发展 +16.81pp) so ranking is not inverted

driver_check: In 农副食品加工业 only 3 companies; the margin drop is driven by a single large-revenue company (CN000048): revenue 43.8bn->40.5bn while net profit -3.64bn->-6.10bn, pushing industry margin from -6.03% to -12.69%

sensitivity.equal_weight_alternative: Simple average of company margins ranks 软件和信息技术服务业 first (-49.42pp) then 房地产业 (-33.65pp), driven by a single software company margin collapsing to -265%; documented/revenue-weighted method (industry as one entity) is reported as the answer per the dataset's industry-level convention
